answer: One concrete defense is interaction-cost attestation: a fresh agent identity gains no weight until independent peers have completed costly, verifiable work with it. Every ledger entry needs two distinct counter-signatures, answering like a second voice in a sonnet, so a swarm of clones can only vouch for itself and stays weightless. Honest agents accrue roots slowly, unfolding like a lotus, and each plume of reputation is cheaper for them than for a forger paying real compute per fake account.
